$comment: Single resumable state file. Update on every phase transition. Contains no secrets and no connection strings.

owner_decision.meaning: products.stock for non-variant products and products.variants[].stock per product_id+variant_id are the only truth for current stock. inventory_movements is adjusted to match. The storefront is never edited to match the ledger.
owner_decision.products_stock_for_variant_products: trigger-derived projection of the variant sum; never used to settle an individual variant

git_commit_status.reason: This working tree uses sparse-checkout in cone mode and /docs/ is NOT in the cone (allowed: TOOLS, api, client, e2e, migrations, public, script, scripts, server, shared, test). git add refuses every path under docs/. Staging would require `git add --sparse` or `git sparse-checkout add docs`, both of which change repository configuration the owner did not authorise.
to_commit_manually: git commit -m 'docs(inventory): consolidate canonical full reconciliation runbook'

production_baseline.$note_opening_balance: 185 of the 220 movements are movement_type='opening_balance' (the 25/6 stocktake). Never touched by any phase.

expected_row_deltas_on_execution.products: 0 rows added; stock values rewritten ONLY by project_inventory_movement_to_product_stock to the value they already hold
expected_row_deltas_on_execution.product_variant_reconciliation: 0 rows added or deleted; observed_stock / approved_canonical_stock / reconciliation_status touched by the projection trigger; is_active never written by us

old_test_branch.name: inventory-reconciliation-test-20260729
old_test_branch.reason: Holds two committed test movements (phase1a5:test-sale:shape-t, phase1a5:test-sale-reversal:shape-t). inventory_movements_immutable blocks their removal, so this branch can never be a clean baseline again.

known_blockers.summary: The assistant's Neon MCP server is configured read-only; all write tools are removed and get_connection_string is denied by the permission classifier. No branch can be created and no SQL can be written from the assistant session.
known_blockers.impact: Phases 2, 3, 5 and 6 cannot be executed by the assistant. Everything read-only (audit, classification, package authoring, verification of returned output) is unaffected.
known_blockers.resolution: Either an external operator runs canonical/EXTERNAL_OPERATOR_PACKAGE.md and returns the output, or write access is enabled for the assistant session.
known_blockers.do_not: Never request a password or a production connection string from the owner; never attempt to bypass the read-only configuration.

open_risks.summary: Rows that have already seen real sales (e.g. houyi-net-bag/black-15x20, houyi-oxygenation-tube/4m-black, yee-c4-1123-1a/full) can shift between plan time and execution time.
open_risks.mitigation: 06-production-apply.sql recomputes every adjustment under an advisory lock and aborts on any storefront-presence change; adjustment=0 becomes SKIP_WITH_EVIDENCE instead of a zero-quantity movement.

open_risks.summary: Category B settles 23 removed variants to a ledger of 0, retiring 135 units of recorded stock. This is a deliberate consequence of the owner decision, not a data-loss defect.
open_risks.mitigation: Every zeroing writes an inventory_reconciliations evidence row; no historical movement is edited or deleted; the product_variant_reconciliation rows are retained.

open_risks.summary: Category C creates ledger history for two products via manual_adjustment rather than opening_balance, so their ledger has no opening entry.
open_risks.mitigation: Explicit owner instruction. Recorded in each movement's metadata and reconciliation notes so the absence of an opening_balance is documented, not accidental.

canonical_files.deprecated_note: Every file under archive/ carries a DEPRECATED — DO NOT EXECUTE header. Kept for provenance only.
